title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-a4n2.3: nonce consumed before tx_queue_push, not recovered on push failure
description:
Commit 1a774fce5 adds a tx_queue_push in lichen_link_tx() (lichen_link_tx.c:171-181) AFTER the nonce is allocated by lichen_link_next_tx() (line 124). If the queue push fails (e.g., queue full, clock failure), the function returns an error but the nonce (epoch/seqnum pair) is already consumed and cannot be recovered.

Impact:
- Each failed push creates a permanent gap in the sequence number space
- Accelerates nonce exhaustion (max 256*65536 = ~16M frames total)
- Sequence number gaps may trigger warning/investigation from peers monitoring for replay or missed frames
- Frame was fully built and signed with this nonce, then discarded

Fix: Move nonce allocation to after the queue push, or make the nonce allocatable (rollback) when the push fails. Currently no mechanism exists to 'return' a nonce.
